   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  March 9, 2026

Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Lopez,
Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications and Public Affairs, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Justin Machuca, Senior
Production Supervisor.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Vice Chair Lopez seconded to approve the minutes for
February 9, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Native Garden Contest

Ms. Ocegueda stated that the Commission will have a booth at both the Artastic and Eggstravagent
events to promote native plants and the contest. Mrs. Ocegueda reported that she is currently having
staff work on contest logo and should have something before the contest launches. Mrs. Ocegueda
informed the Commission she is having difficulty contacting the Cerritos College Native Plant Sanctuary
to secure the gift certificates due to their server rejecting city emails but will continue to try to reach
them.

PastForward Series

Mrs. Ocegueda reported that the first video is currently being edited and will be ready released publicly
at the end of the month. Mrs. Ocegueda will email a link to Commissioners to view the video before it’s
release. Mr. Machuca provided insight about the publishing platforms.

Merchandise

Mrs. Ocegueda stated she has not reached out to the contact Commissioner Sanchez provided at the
last meeting. Commissioners did not have updates on additional vendors.

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Mr. Sun presented the “Keepin’ It Norwalk” campaign video, February Chinese Food edition, to the
Commissioners. Mr. Machuca provided statistics. Ms. Ocegueda reported that the vinyl stickers are in
progress.

Communications Analytics

Mr. Sun and Mr. Machuca provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and
the city’s overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
March 9, 2026

Community Band

Chair Ang presented an exploratory proposal to create a volunteer-based community band. Chair Ang
provided background on the All-City Band that was formed in 1976 but dissolved in 2020 and is the
reasoning behind Chair Ang’s presentation although he clarified this proposal is for a new entity, not a
reformation of the old band. Chair Ang envisions the purpose of the band would be to provide live
music at civic events, offer a creative outlet for local musicians, and foster civic pride. Commissioner
Sanchez expressed concern about who would take lead as band director if a band was to be formed.
Vice Chair Lopez suggested conducting a survey to see if there is community interest. Mr. Sun
confirmed a survey like the merchandise one could be conducted. Chair Ang made the motion to create
and conduct a community band survey. All Commissioners agreed. There being no objection, the
motion carried.

   Resident Armida Leon requested clarification about recruitment criteria and funding details. She
  concurred that the survey is a good start.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mr. Sun reminded Chair Ang and Vice Chair Lopez to attend a Brown Act training on March 25, 2026
at 5:00 pm in the City Council Chambers.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez confirmed that the date for the Halloween Parade has been changed to
October 17, 2026. Chair Ang inquired if the survey for the community band would be ready for use at
the Artastic event. Staff confirmed a QR-based survey will be created in time of the event.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:18 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
